pitch_detail.notes: Starts from the grassy col, where the rope and rack come out after the long ramp-and-ledge scramble from the snow. Blocky terrain makes for straightforward climbing to the first belay.
The crux. A dihedral looks like the natural line but dead-ends, so the leader steps left onto the open face and finishes up a hand crack.
Quite easy ground that connects the hard pitches below to the steeper climbing above.
A steep flake of good quality gives the climbing on this pitch.
A rightward traverse leads to the foot of the summit tower. No grade is recorded for it.
A steep face about two-thirds of the way up the tower. It is run out, so expect little protection between the holds.

A moderate rightward traverse that feels wild and exposed, on solid rock with almost nothing to protect it. It ends in the notch between the summit tower and a neighbouring pinnacle, which marks the end of the difficulties.
One easy but loose pitch from the notch to the summit; test blocks before weighting them.

review.changed: Wrote all 8 pitches from the first-ascent account, which gives grades for 1, 2, 4 and 6 only. No lengths, bolt counts or anchors are stated, so none were written. Grades for pitches 3, 5, 7 and 8 left out. Single source.
review.other_findings: Stored pitch count (8) and grade (5.10-) match the source. The source describes no descent.

skip_reasons.wa_dragontail_peak_northwest_face: No page found for a Beckey/Davis 1962 5.9 Northwest Face on Dragontail. The Mountain Project 'Northwest Face' hit is a different peak (Forbidden, 5.8); other Dragontail NW-face lines (Serpentine Ridge, Backbone Ridge) are different routes. Cannot confirm the line, so skipped.
skip_reasons.wa_east_mcmillan_spire_northeast_buttres: Only a summary article exists (25 pitches, daily pitch totals, grade spread); no pitch-by-pitch account. The Mountain Project 'Northeast Buttress' hit is a different peak. Nothing to write without inventing pitches.
skip_reasons.wa_east_twin_needle_north_buttress: No pitch-level source found; only route history and attempt reports surfaced. Skipped.
skip_reasons.wa_garfield_mountain_east_rib: No source found for a Garfield Mountain East Rib at all (stored row has no grade, length or first ascent). Cannot confirm the line.
skip_reasons.wa_garfield_mountain_southeast_face: No source found for this Garfield line. The Mountain Project 'Southeast Face' hit is the Lotus Flower Tower route in the Nahanni, a different route. Skipped.
skip_reasons.wa_golden_horn_northeast_arete: Only a general description (five pitches, 5.8, loose flakes) found; no pitch-by-pitch account. Skipped.
